description.value: Tod Mountain Cafe is a mountain-inspired café in Sun Peaks village serving ethically sourced, small-batch roasted coffee alongside an all-day breakfast menu of crêpes, bagel sandwiches, burritos, and avocado toast. The café emphasizes locally sourced seasonal ingredients and describes a warm, comfortable atmosphere suited to refueling after outdoor adventure. It is a natural stop for cyclists passing through or based at Sun Peaks Resort.

address.value: 3170 Creekside Way, Sun Peaks, BC V0E 5N0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is accessible and confirms a real café at 3170 Creekside Way, Sun Peaks, BC with a detailed menu (espresso drinks, breakfast items, crêpes) aligning with OSM cuisine tags. OSM tags diet:gluten_free=yes and diet:vegetarian=yes are supported by the menu (avocado toast, vegetarian-friendly items) though not stated explicitly on the website. The phone number displayed site-wide ('1.234-5678') and the contact email ('admin@gmail.com') are clearly template placeholders and should not be used as real contact info.
concerns: Phone number shown on website ('1.234-5678') is a template placeholder, not a real BC phone number. No usable phone contact available.
